overall_summary: Recent 7-day performance data clearly shows that 'What If' hypothetical scenarios combined with extreme space anomalies (e.g., liquid diamond planets, dark planets, and burning ice worlds) generate the highest views-per-day and robust engagement (likes-per-view). In contrast, older or standard biological facts and psychological tricks published over 14 days ago exhibit significantly lower velocity. Growth should double down on high-concept space 'What If' scenarios utilizing vivid environmental visualization and sensory hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Darkest Planet?' (YlDuGu1vzAg) gathered over 1,000 and 800 views respectively within days of publication, far outperforming standard encyclopedic facts.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more extreme hypothetical planetary immersion scenarios featuring bizarre physics, extreme temperatures, or exotic materials.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing impossible weather such as 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal' (v1rrcZLdp4U) consistently capture strong view counts and engagement relative to channel age.
winning_patterns.action: Highlight surreal, high-contrast atmospheric conditions on newly discovered or theoretical exoplanets in future hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5AN7LUgqarc, 2fqaGqfsR4A) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs' (ef3ND4qiRHc) stagnated with very low view counts (<75 views) despite repeat observations.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks and cognitive bias listicles unless reframed with a high-stakes narrative or cinematic mystery hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Simple animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (AXAfwrzzEdU) or general biology trivia generated minimal traction compared to cosmic survival scenarios.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid straightforward biological listicles unless tied to cinematic animal survival or prehistoric apex predator mysteries.
